title: Decouple lease allocator and add cross-zone subnet binding for GPU nodepools
author: Noah Kim
release_notes: Introduces a decoupled lease allocator module and cross-zone subnet binding for GPU nodepools. Requires running the provided tfstate-handoff script to migrate existing GPU pool state to the new per-tenant state layout. Rolling upgrade instructions added. Operators must run 'scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh --dry-run' then follow the migration checklist in docs/migrations/2025-11-lease-allocator.md. This change may briefly perturb nodepool provisioning during migration windows.
description: Motivation: private installs with tightly-coupled GPU pool state were causing long terraform plans and contention during tenant onboarding. This PR splits the lease allocator (tenant GPU lease lifecycle) into an independently versioned terraform module and introduces cross-zone subnet binding so tenant leases can be satisfied across AZs without manual subnet reconfiguration. Design: 1) modules/lease-allocator becomes a standalone module exposing lease table, IAM bindings, and a small controller CRD input for the installer chart. 2) modules/gpu-nodepool gains a 'subnet_bindings' input which accepts a prioritized list of subnet ids per AZ; the module generates per-zone attachments and a lightweight routing policy. 3) We introduce scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh which orchestrates state moves (terraform state mv + backend lock handling) from the legacy combined tfstate to tenant-scoped statefiles. 4) Installer chart values updated to reference the new module outputs and the operator-facing migration toggle. Rollout and migration plan: a) Deploy the new installer chart with migration=enabled in a maintenance window. b) Run scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh in dry-run to validate moves. c) Run the handoff script to move state and reapply the new modules. d) Observe nodepool provisioning with canary tenant before full rollout. Backout: the handoff script supports a safe revert plan: it checkpoints state backups and can reverse state moves in case of issues. Testing: unit tf plan/test for modules, integration test that simulates two tenants competing for GPU leases across two AZs, and an e2e smoke test to validate subnet failover. Security: IAM reshuffle minimal and scoped to tenant roles; included policy tightening for assume-role bindings. Migration docs and checklist added. Checklist: [x] terraform module + tests, [x] handoff script, [x] installer values, [x] docs, [x] reviewer approvals. Context/related: complements ENG-1740 (gpu scheduler pressure fixes) and is preparatory work for upcoming per-tenant metrics export.

diff_snippet: modules/lease-allocator: resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "lease_table" { ... } -> exports lease_table_arn; modules/gpu-nodepool: variable "subnet_bindings" { type = list(object({ az = string, subnets = list(string) })) } used to create aws_subnet_attachment per AZ; scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh: implemented --dry-run, --apply and backend lock handling.
review_comments: Ava Martinez: Please add a migration dry-run step to the README and ensure the handoff script cleans up locks. (addressed)
Liam O'Connor: Add acceptance tests for cross-AZ failover — we need to ensure KV cache warmup doesn't cause double allocations. (added integration test that mocks allocation timing)
Priya Desai: IAM least-privilege check: the new assume-role ARN pattern looks broad. Request narrowing to tenant-scoped role naming. (narrowed names and updated tests)
notes_for_ops: Before merging, schedule a maintenance window and coordinate with SRE. Run 'scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh --backend-config /path/to/backend --dry-run' to validate. Ensure backups of remote state are taken. Follow docs/migrations/2025-11-lease-allocator.md step-by-step. After migration, monitor metrics: GPU.Leases.Success, GPU.Leases.Failures, installer.nodepool.reconcile_latency.
operational_impact: Temporary terraform plan times may increase during state handoff. Small risk of brief nodepool reprovisioning if migration interleaves with autoscaler events. Recommended maintenance window of 30-60 minutes per region.
testing_summary: Unit: module inputs/outputs validated; Integration: simulated two tenants across us-east-1a/us-east-1b with allocation handoff; E2E: deploy installer with migration toggle and run canary tenant flow. All tests passed in CI (see pipeline links).
changelog_entry: Decouple lease allocator and enable cross-zone subnet binding for GPU nodepools. Includes migration tooling for tfstate handoff. (operators: run migration script as documented)
security_review: Scoped IAM changes reviewed by security; updated assume-role patterns and documented role ARNs in migration doc.
backout_instructions: Use 'scripts/tfstate-handoff.sh --revert' which restores state backups and re-applies legacy combined modules. If necessary, set installer migration toggle back to false and re-apply previous chart revision.
audits: Included tfsec scan and policy checks; CI terraform fmt/lint passed
performance_considerations: Decoupling reduces plan time for tenant operations and allows independent scaling of the allocator. Cross-zone binding adds a small cost for additional networking resources but reduces tenant provisioning failures in AZ-constrained pools.
